candidates.case_status: On Sunday 18 October 2026, around 7 pm, Tiger Shroff's car was fired at as it left a football ground in Juhu, Mumbai; no bullet hit him. His driver Firdaus Ibrahim Baloch and a fan, Umesh Chauhan, were hit by bullets and are in hospital, stable. All three accused were caught on the morning of Monday 19 October aboard the Pune-Jaipur Express at Kota Junction, Rajasthan, and taken to Mumbai; the Mumbai Police Crime Branch is investigating. Police say five rounds were fired (some outlets report seven). Police say the motive is not yet established and have not verified a social media claim of responsibility.

case_hurt.en: Two people were hit by bullets: Tiger Shroff's driver Firdaus Ibrahim Baloch and a fan, Umesh Chauhan; both are in hospital and stable. Nobody died, and no bullet hit Tiger Shroff.
